title: 02-04-2025 South Jordan City Council Meeting Minutes - FINAL

votes.motion: Council Member Zander motioned to approve Ordinance 2025-06, Amending Section 17.130.050 (Planned Development Floating Zone) of the South Jordan Municipal Code to include the area east of the FrontRunner rail line in eligible areas for density greater than eight dwelling units per acre with an amendment to the proposed Ordinance to add “primarily commercial”
Council Member Johnson motioned to adjourn the February 4, 2025 City Council Meeting
